description.zh:
标签键。

当标签键下没有任何标签值时，可以仅设置`Key`，删除该标签键。否则，请同时设置`Key`和`Value`，删除指定的预置标签。
description.en:
The tag key.

If no tag value is associated with a tag key, you can specify the `Key` parameter without specifying the Value parameter to delete the tag key. Otherwise, you must specify both the `Key` and `Value` parameters to delete a preset tag.

The region ID.

> Only `cn-hangzhou` is supported.

descriptions.zh: 本文将提供一个示例，删除标签键为`Environment`，标签值为`test`的预置标签。
descriptions.en: This topic provides an example on how to call the API operation to delete the preset tag whose tag key is `Environment` and tag value is `test`.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun tag delete-tag --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --key Environment --value test --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun tag DeleteTag --region cn-hangzhou --Value test --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Key Environment
